author: TommyWeeks
body:
Application
Age:  14
Timezone: -3 GMT Argentine
Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes/No:  Yes
Do you have access to Skype? Yes/No:  Yes
Do you have access to a recording software? Yes/No: Yes 

CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION

Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers? If throughout my career as a Minecraft player I was Staff on all types of servers, from Survival to Skywars, I am also very happy because I met great people and friends.

What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating? My biggest weakness is when there is a lot of chat problem (abusive spam, flood etc), well I think it would not affect much because at the moment that happens I will have to start sanctioning.
My greatest strength is to solve situations very quickly, the good thing about this is that I could solve everything quickly without problems.


How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team? I could contribute my hours connected, I spend many hours of the day playing and that time could take advantage of playing / moderating on the server.

What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why? First of all, respectful, kind, mature and intelligent.
I do not know if leader is the correct term, but I have very good relationship with people and that could lead me to be one of the most beloved.
What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator? As I said before, the ability to solve problems very fast, this would be essential in case of conflicts, if there is any disturbance intervene and if necessary I warn and give sanctions.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills? Honest, kind, respectful, mature, etc.
Of course as I said before I am very kind and respectful and that could lead me to have good interaction with people.


How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)?  1 year or a year and a half.


CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS

You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do? First of all I look at if there are reports on the, if there is, I become an observer and I start to follow, if it is very obvious will give the correct sanction and if it is difficult to see or rare it would call an SS.


Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do? I would try to talk to the leaders because that is the function of the referee, to arbitrate that there is nothing strange, but if you are really accusing I talk with the Head Ref.


A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do? I show him which part of the rules is what he did not comply with and talk to him to reach a solution.

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do? It would completely erase the publication, because if it is of the utmost importance to the Staff for something it will be, so I would quickly erase the photo and talk to the user to know where he got it (if not part of the staff)


One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do? I would talk to Mr. Mod to know the full reasons why I make that decision, just to be sure that the decision is well taken.


CRITERIA 3: OTHER
NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.


What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you? For me it is something brilliant to be part of a Staff, I always had the opportunity in server and I liked, to what I liked to do, to play Minecraft and to be an important person inside the server.
For me it would be a great honor to be part of the Staff, not to attract attention, but to know what it feels like to be a Staff on a very active and important server as Avicus is.


How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you? Honestly it was always one of my favorite servers, here I learned everything about PvP, I played in Badlion, Kohi, OCN etc and they killed me because it was not so good. This server gave me the opportunity to be part of amazing competition teams, with which I am happy.
For my Avicus is a fantastic server, especially its players, all have Fair Play, are respectful would give anything to be part of the server, I really love Avicus.


Do you speak any other languages than English? I speak Spanish (Native), English, a little of French and Portuguese.


Do you have anything else to add to your application?
Since these are my last words I want to say that:
I would give anything to be part of the staff, you can trust me, I will not disappoint you, if I am denied, it does not matter, things do not always go the way you want. If I am denied I will help the server in other ways by reporting, translating, donating, playing, etc.
